newsitem.title: UK: Britain's Prudential raises operating profit.
newsitem.headline: Britain's Prudential raises operating profit.

text.p: British insurance and asset management giant Prudential Corp Plc on Wednesday said its operating profit rose by eight percent to 421 million pounds compared with 390 million in the first half of last year.
The Prudential, which next month will also launch a telephone banking business, also raised its interim dividend by 9.4 percent to 5.8 pence per share.
The first half data included 33 million pounds of start-up costs for the new banking operation which chief executive Peter Davis said was on course for launch on October 1.
Davis said the company's strategic goal of concentrating on retail financial services and fund management were underlined by its sale of the reinsurance unit Mercantile & General.
This and other sales will generate funds of 1.8 billion pounds ($2.80 billion) which Davis said will be used to further strategic objectives.

Davis said business was "continuing to go well" in the second half of the year with customers feeling a little more confident but still more interested in single-payment business rather than a longer-term commitment. ($1=.6436 Pound)
